description: This file defines a class RoutingEventsInsights with methods for fetching and processing routing form data, including filtering, retrieving headers, options, and exporting data as CSV. It interacts with Prisma ORM and external libraries for data manipulation and formatting.

classes.name: RoutingEventsInsights
classes.description: A class providing static methods to fetch, filter, process, and export routing form response data, including handling form headers, options, and CSV conversion.

methods.name: getWhereForTeamOrAllTeams
methods.description: Constructs Prisma where input for filtering forms based on team, organization, user, and form ID.

methods.name: getRoutingFormsForFilters
methods.description: Retrieves routing forms matching specified filters, including team and organization filters.

methods.name: getRoutingFormPaginatedResponsesForDownload
methods.description: Fetches and processes routing form responses, flattening nested data and formatting date/time fields for download.

methods.name: getRoutingFormFieldOptions
methods.description: Retrieves form fields options for a given set of filters.

methods.name: getRoutingFormHeaders
methods.description: Fetches form headers (fields) for specified filters, filtering out duplicates and invalid types.

methods.name: objectToCsv
methods.description: Converts an array of objects into CSV string format, escaping necessary characters.
